## How you checked it

<!-- Screenshots or a short clip of the result are the fastest review. -->

- [ ] Optional fields hide cleanly when emptied

- [ ] All tests in `tests/` pass (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
